keyEvents.text: Delay in match (Cambuur).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Goal! Utrecht 0, Cambuur 1. Nicolas Binder (Cambuur) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Jason Çeka.
First Half ends, Utrecht 0, Cambuur 1.
Substitution, Utrecht. Davy van den Berg replaces Per Kloosterboer.
Substitution, Utrecht. Arthur Zagré replaces Oualid Agougil.
Second Half begins Utrecht 0, Cambuur 1.
Dani de Wit (Utrecht) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Delay in match because of an injury Devid Eugene Bouah (Cambuur).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Mathieu Maertens (Cambuur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Utrecht 0, Cambuur 2. Ilyès Hamache (Cambuur) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Rafik El Arguioui following a fast break.
Substitution, Utrecht. Nordin Amrabat replaces Marius Broholm.
Substitution, Cambuur. Daan Visser replaces Mathieu Maertens.
Arthur Zagré (Utrecht) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Utrecht 1, Cambuur 2. Artem Stepanov (Utrecht) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Joris van Overeem.
Substitution, Utrecht. Adrian Blake replaces Nikolas Panagiotou.
Substitution, Cambuur. Sami Bouhoudane replaces Rafik El Arguioui.
Billy van Duijl (Cambuur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Utrecht. Sem van Duijn replaces Artem Stepanov.
Daan Visser (Cambuur) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Utrecht 2, Cambuur 2. Sem van Duijn (Utrecht) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Adrian Blake following a fast break.
Substitution, Cambuur. Wout Asselman replaces Jason Çeka.
Substitution, Cambuur. Rik Mulders replaces Devid Eugene Bouah.
Substitution, Cambuur. Iwan Henstra replaces Nicolas Binder.
Goal! Utrecht 2, Cambuur 3. Morgan Costarelli (Cambuur) left footed shot from the left side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Sami Bouhoudane with a through ball.
Second Half ends, Utrecht 2, Cambuur 3.
